metas.name: 1 · ★ 5.6 · 1986 · No Retreat, No Surrender
metas.description: Jason, a Bruce Lee fan, sees his karate instructor/dad beaten by martial art thugs. They move to Seattle where, after humiliations, he trains with Bruce Lee's ghost so he can defend himself and others against thugs.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 5.1 · 1987 · No Retreat, No Surrender 2
metas.description: In this sequel, Scott Wylde, an American kickboxer, must go to Cambodia to rescue his Vietnamese girlfriend from Russian and Vietnamese troops.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 6.4 · 1989 · Kickboxer
metas.description: Kurt Sloane must learn the ancient kick boxing art of Muay Thai in order to avenge his brother.

metas.name: 4 · ★ 6.4 · 1989 · Best of the Best
metas.description: A team from the United States is going to compete against Korea in a Tae Kwon Do tournament. The team consists of fighters from all over the country - can they overcome their rivalry and work together to win?

metas.name: 5 · ★ 5.9 · 1990 · The King of the Kickboxers
metas.description: A cop goes undercover in Thailand to avenge his brother's death in this martial arts film.

metas.name: 6 · ★ 4.3 · 1992 · Kickboxer 3: The Art of War
metas.description: David Sloan travels to Rio for a kick-box exhibition. There he saves two youngsters and stops a white slaver.

metas.name: 7 · ★ 4.7 · 1995 · Fists of Iron
metas.description: A skillful fighter who works as a mechanic goes with his friend to a rich guy's villa where illegal fighting is being organizes. It should be easy money, but the friend gets killed and now the mechanic wants revenge on the people ...

metas.name: 8 · ★ 5.7 · 1995 · Superfights
metas.description: Jack Cody has always wanted to enter the world of the Superfights, a free fighting tournament. One night, Jack rescues a girl from a mugging and becomes a national hero. Only then is he given his opportunity to become a Superfighter. Jack soon meets a ninja who informs him that the man behind the Superfights is involved in illegal acts. Armed with this knowledge Jack must fight . . . for his life!

metas.name: 9 · ★ 3.9 · 1997 · Champions
